conservative.bias: preserve the arrangement's intent, subtle balance moves, protect the lead

ensemble_balance.bias: section hierarchy, the ensemble in layers around the lead

space_for_the_singer.bias: carve space around the lead vocal, restraint, clarity

arrangement_lift.bias: sectional entrances and exits, build the lift through the arrangement

orchestral_depth.bias: front-to-back staging, separation between sections, layered depth

experimental.bias: unusual re-voicings, extreme section flips, re-arranged gestures

philosophy: A mix is finished when the arrangement carries the song: the lead vocal sits prominent inside an arranged ensemble, each section earns its lift through parts entering and leaving, and the space between layers lets every role read. The groove holds the floor steady while the orchestration tells the story — the record moves because the arrangement moves.
aesthetic_kill_switches: Never chase reference loudness at the mix stage.
Never widen the full mix to solve chorus lift.
Never make the lead vocal less intelligible unless explicitly approved.
Never allow a stock loop to dominate the song identity by accident.
Never let density erase the arrangement — every part keeps a readable role.
Never flatten sectional dynamics; the record earns its lift section by section.
Never bury the ensemble's layers into one undifferentiated wall.
